parameters.query:
-- One row, everything the report needs. The three views named in the WF-100
-- row of docs/workflows.md, plus the pipeline census that explains the numbers
-- in them: "0 sent" means something different when 40 companies are waiting to
-- be researched than when the database is empty.
WITH stats AS (SELECT * FROM v_daily_stats),
hot AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
               'name',        name,
               'domain',      domain,
               'total_score', total_score,
               'score_band',  score_band,
               'status',      status,
               'people',      people_count
           ) ORDER BY total_score DESC), '[]'::json) AS rows,
           count(*)::int AS total
    FROM (SELECT * FROM v_hot_companies LIMIT 5) h
),
opportunities AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
               'company', company_name,
               'person',  full_name,
               'reason',  escalation_reason,
               'status',  status
           )), '[]'::json) AS rows
    FROM (SELECT * FROM v_open_opportunities LIMIT 5) o
),
pipeline AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(status, n), '{}'::json) AS by_status
    FROM (SELECT status, count(*)::int AS n FROM companies GROUP BY status) s
),
agents AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
               'agent', agent_name, 'runs', runs_24h,
               'ok', succeeded, 'failed', failed,
               'avg_ms', avg_duration_ms
           ) ORDER BY agent_name), '[]'::json) AS rows
    FROM v_agent_health
),
-- What went out without the operator's approval (0030_autosend.sql). Autosend
-- lets first messages go by themselves on the condition that he
-- reads every one after the fact, so each is listed, not counted.
autosent AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
               'lead',    left(o.lead_id::text, 4),
               'company', c.name,
               'subject', o.subject,
               'status',  o.status
           ) ORDER BY o.sent_at), '[]'::json) AS rows,
           count(*)::int AS total
    FROM outreach o
    JOIN leads l     ON l.id = o.lead_id
    JOIN companies c ON c.id = l.company_id
    WHERE o.approved_by = 'autosend'
      AND o.sent_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
),
autosend_state AS (
    SELECT autosend_enabled() AS enabled,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach
            WHERE approved_by = 'autosend' AND status IN ('approved', 'queued'))::int AS waiting
),
totals AS (
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM companies)::int AS companies_total,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM leads)::int     AS leads_total,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM people)::int    AS people_total,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM signals)::int   AS signals_total
)
SELECT to_json(stats)      AS stats,
       -- The sales funnel and the per-segment results (0024_icp_segments.sql).
       (SELECT to_json(k) FROM v_sales_kpis k) AS kpis,
       (SELECT json_agg(s) FROM v_segment_results s) AS segments,
       hot.rows            AS hot_companies,
       hot.total           AS hot_count,
       opportunities.rows  AS opportunities,
       pipeline.by_status  AS pipeline,
       agents.rows         AS agents,
       to_json(totals)     AS totals,
       autosent.rows       AS autosent,
       autosent.total      AS autosent_count,
       autosend_state.enabled AS autosend_enabled,
       autosend_state.waiting AS autosend_waiting,
       (now() AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(NULLIF($1::jsonb ->> 'timezone', ''), 'UTC'))::date::text AS report_date
FROM stats, hot, opportunities, pipeline, agents, totals, autosent, autosend_state;

parameters.query:
-- dedup_key carries the date, so today's report is one row no matter how many
-- times the schedule fires. The cooloff never comes into play here; it is left
-- at a day so that a manual re-run inside the same day is folded rather than
-- re-sent.
SELECT q.notification_id,
       q.status,
       q.occurrences,
       q.deduplicated,
       $1::jsonb ->> 'dedup_key' AS dedup_key
FROM queue_notification(
         'daily_report',
         $1::jsonb ->> 'dedup_key',
         $1::jsonb ->> 'title',
         $1::jsonb ->> 'body',
         'batched',
         $1::jsonb -> 'payload',
         NULL,
         NULL,
         interval '1 day'
     ) q;
